description: Source estate for Azura World Residence & Hotel. This file is DATA. Adding, retiring or re-pointing a source must never require editing scripts/harvest-azura.mjs. Tier order is CONTRACTS.md §1 and decides the DISPLAY value on a conflict; it never deletes the losing value.
revisionNotes: v2: three ticket URLs corrected against evidence, not guesswork. (a) Booking.com — the ticket's /hotel/tr/azura-world.html is a DIFFERENT property (a private apartment near Alanya centre); the hotel kept its pre-rebrand slug /hotel/tr/wyndham-alanya.html. Both are harvested: the wrong one as evidence for the finding. (b) TERRA — the ticket's /de/wohnprojekt/ path does not exist; canonical is /project/azura-world-residence-and-villas and no German variant was established. (c) Tripadvisor — g/d ids resolved to g1069655/d33144231.

v2: alanya-home publishes the same project under TWO ids (466 and 891) at two different entry prices. Both are harvested as separate sources; the disagreement is a Finding, not something to pick between.
v2: per-unit listing URLs are DISCOVERED by following links from container pages (followListingLinks), not hand-copied, so the pipeline reproduces itself.

HTTP 500 to plain fetch. Probed under Playwright on 2026-07-27: the detail path serves a CodeIgniter error body ('Unable to load the requested file: front/404.php'), i.e. the developer's own project page is broken, not merely bot-walled. Tier-2 corroboration therefore stays unavailable — F-010.
Recovers under Playwright. Confirms 'Alanya / Türkler' and lists both Azura World Residence & Hotel and a separate Wyndham Hotel Alanya in the same portfolio — relevant to F-007.

SECOND page for the SAME project on the SAME portal, at a different entry price (from €125,000 / 80–300 m² vs 466's from €220,000 / from 85 m²). One publisher contradicting itself is still a conflict and is recorded as one — not silently deduplicated to the 'better' page.
Quotes USD, not EUR — F-002. Also the outlier block count (3) in F-001.

requiresHeaded: a headless context gets 'Please enable JS and disable any ad blocker' (403); a headed one gets the full review page. That is a property of the source, so it lives here rather than in an operator's memory of which flag to pass. The same d-id previously carried the name 'Wyndham Alanya': Tripadvisor renamed the property in place, which is direct evidence for F-007.

HOTEL account. Distinct from the developer's accounts — hotel and residence sales run separate social presences.
DEVELOPER account. Confirmed from the footer of azuraworld.com itself — a primary source, so the ticket's guess is verified rather than assumed.

Second independent host for 7 blocks / 656 units / 76,000 m². Conflates green area with outdoor facility area (F-008).
THE CORRECT PROPERTY. Booking kept the pre-rebrand slug after the Wyndham → Azura World rename, which is itself evidence for F-007.
Review detail for criterion 4.

THE TICKET'S URL, harvested deliberately as EVIDENCE, not as data. Search metadata describes a private 2-bedroom apartment near Alanya centre (Damlataş Cave / Alanya Aquapark ≈15 km from Türkler), not the 5★ hotel. Harvesting it is how the claim gets tested instead of asserted; nothing from it may enter hotel facts.

Names the rebrand explicitly — primary evidence for F-007. allowRedirect deliberately NOT set: on 2026-07-27 this URL bounced to /en-gb/city/alanya-tr.html, i.e. the property record is gone, and a tolerated redirect would have recorded a city index page as a hotel source.
UK package market. Second host naming the ex-Wyndham branding. requiresHeaded: headless gets a 403 wall, headed gets the full page.
Russian-language source — serves the ru locale. Currently states it is updating its inventory, so unit data may be absent.
Carries a per-layout price table with no per-unit links. Its 1+1 €/m² is far out of line with Haspo and Seaside — a conflict to record, never to average away.
Domain did not resolve during URL verification. Kept in the register so the failure is recorded rather than the source quietly disappearing.

unitListingSources.notes: The only portal publishing true per-unit detail pages for this project. Unit URLs are DISCOVERED from this index rather than hand-listed, so the pipeline reproduces itself when the inventory changes. Prices render client-side, which is exactly why this runs under Playwright. Everything harvested here inherits isStale: true (F-006).
Carries unit rows with portal reference ids (F-xxxx). The refs render as page content rather than separate URLs, so the container page is the citation for each unit.
Aggregated per-layout pricing in USD. Follow may yield nothing — an empty follow set is recorded, not treated as failure.

1+1 / 70 m² inside Azura World, but priced PER MONTH as a rental. Flagged priceKind: rent so a €2,100 rent can never contaminate the sale-price series in F-002. This is precisely the kind of unit that a naive scraper turns into a fake bargain.
